_about: Polish1 F1a: the rock of a country's land, laid by core/fantasy_layout.gd country_rocks() over the looks' own clutter. stone: which stone each look's rock is (crag_<stone>, scree_<stone> and its boulder). slots: tries a 50 m piece of land. steep = metres up a metre of ground (0.5 = 27 degrees, 1 = 45). crag: outcrops breaking out of steep ground, faced downhill, sunk deep; their chance grows from nothing at height low to full at high (metres), so low country keeps its hills grassy; mountain_grow: how much bigger they are high up (from high to twice high). scree: loose stones below them on the middle slopes. boulder: on gentler ground, more of them high up (height in metres: low .. high). tilt: how much a piece leans with the slope (0 upright, 1 fully).
